title: Walker and the Cosmos Club

tellings.quote: >> Walker was Walker was one of the one of the people that's one of the things we discovered

plain: Grant Cameron, a researcher who studies government UFO secrecy, spoke on Jesse Michels's podcast about a man named Eric Walker and the Cosmos Club, a private club for scholars and officials in Washington, D.C. Cameron says Walker was one of the people his research turned up, in a way he presents as a discovery. He tells it because he links Walker to the small circle he believes knew about hidden UFO matters.
